security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A weather app with a living sky.
bundle.longDescription: Weather shows current conditions and forecasts from Open-Meteo under a real-time WebGL sky that follows the sun, moon and weather.
